title: Cost-Sharing of TRICARE Select Inpatient Facility Stays
content:
**Adjudication rule.** An inpatient facility line under **TRICARE Select** is cost-shared by the stay, not by the day of posting. Under per diem with minimum the beneficiary pays the daily charge times the inpatient days, but never less than the minimum charge for the admission; under lesser of per diem or percent the beneficiary pays the lesser of the daily charge times the inpatient days and the stated percent of the facility allowed amount; under per admission copayment the beneficiary pays the admission copayment once per stay; under percent of allowed the beneficiary pays the stated percent of the allowed amount. Network stays use the network basis and amounts, non-network stays the non-network ones. Separately billed professional services during the stay are outpatient lines. A non-emergency inpatient mental health admission needs an approved authorization before it is payable.

## The four bases on a paid stay

| Basis | Beneficiary pays |
|---|---|
| per diem with minimum | the higher of the daily charge multiplied by the inpatient days and the minimum charge for the admission |
| lesser of per diem or percent | the lower of the daily charge multiplied by the inpatient days and the stated percent of the facility allowed amount (that percent rounded to the cent) |
| per admission copayment | the admission copayment, once per stay |
| percent of allowed | the stated percent of the allowed amount |

These apply to acute inpatient admissions and inpatient mental health admissions that are paid.

## Worked stays (hypothetical)

- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, non-network, 2 days, allowed amount 5000.00: the lesser of 2382.00 (1191.00 times 2) and 1250.00 (25 percent): 1250.00.
- TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4), network, 3 days: 21.15 times 3 is 63.45, above the 25.00 minimum: 63.45.
- A surgeon's separately billed visit during the stay is an outpatient line, cost-shared as outpatient care.
